install: set -euo pipefail; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" "$HOME/.local/share"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; ARCH=$(uname -m); case "$ARCH" in aarch64|arm64) NVIM_ARCH=arm64 ;; *) NVIM_ARCH=x86_64 ;; esac; NVIM_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/nvim-v0.11.4"; if [ ! -x "$NVIM_DIR/bin/nvim" ]; then TMP=$(mktemp -d); curl -fsSL -o "$TMP/nvim.tar.gz" "https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/download/v0.11.4/nvim-linux-${NVIM_ARCH}.tar.gz"; tar -xzf "$TMP/nvim.tar.gz" -C "$TMP"; rm -rf "$NVIM_DIR"; mv "$TMP/nvim-linux-${NVIM_ARCH}" "$NVIM_DIR"; rm -rf "$TMP"; fi; ln -sfn "$NVIM_DIR/bin/nvim" "$HOME/.local/bin/nvim"; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '[ "$1" = "-p" ] && shift' 'for f in "$@"; do LUAC_FILE="$f" nvim --clean --headless +"lua local ok, err = loadfile(os.getenv([[LUAC_FILE]])) if not ok then io.stderr:write(err, string.char(10)) os.exit(1) end os.exit(0)" || exit 1; done' > "$HOME/.local/bin/luac" && chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/luac"; if ! (command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1 && clang-format --version | grep -E 'version 21\.' >/dev/null); then if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv tool install --upgrade 'clang-format>=21,<22'; else pipx install --force 'clang-format>=21,<22'; fi; fi; if ! command -v gcovr >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq gcovr; fi; (cd vscode && npm ci)
